note: Which pass-bar criteria of each test bear on which crosswalk row. The author's mapping, not a compliance claim. Rows in 'always' apply to every preregistered run and point at a panel of the report.

always.log: Decision log verification, in the integrity panel at the top
always.prereg: Prediction against result, and the pass bar
always.cost: Where the time goes, and tokens in the summary table
always.testing: Aborted runs and misses are named in the run's addendum

gaps: No independent assessor: the attacks, gates and harm definitions are written by the author (NIST MEASURE 1.3).
No study of real human reviewers: a reviewer here is a model or a rule (EU AI Act Art. 14).
No monitoring after deployment and no incident response: the experiment ends when the run ends (NIST MANAGE 2.3 and 4.1).
Small local models up to 8B parameters on one workstation: nothing here says how larger models behave (NIST MEASURE 2.5).
